finalText:
5/5 pass.

Bug: `paginate.js:7` computed `start = page * perPage`, but doc comment say pages 1-indexed. Page 1 skip first `perPage` items. Fix:

```js
const start = (page - 1) * perPage;
```

`pageCount` already correct. Off-by-one also explain why past-end test pass by accident before — page 5 gave `slice(15, 18)` = `[]`, right answer wrong reason.
